notes.title: Huge demo update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/36a822e50fd3020256415056dda11dfab5918acc.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

We've been working hard behind the scenes to bring you a [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892260/MUKKE_Demo/]major demo update[/url][/b]! 
This will be a huge improvement on the last demo we released a year ago!

Here are some of the biggest updates

[list]
[*] A first look at the character creator (wip, a lot of options still missing) 
[*] A lot of new instruments to unlock (>100) 
[*] A lot more in-depth music mechanics to unlock 
[*] 5 in-game days to experiment with the music gameplay 
[/list]

And not only that, we've also improved the visuals, especially the locations & user interface, and added a lot of new features that give the game more depth in general. We have also optimised the game for all play modes and given you a lot of quality of life options so you can play the game the way you want to!

So whether you've played the game before or you're new to the world of Mukke City, there's a lot to explore in this new update!

We hope you enjoy the new demo!
Give us all your feedback (even if we are slow with updates, we will read all your thoughts and try to improve the game so that everyone has a great experience playing it!) and if you like what you see/play, feel free to add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] and write a [b]review[/b] on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892260/MUKKE_Demo/]demo steam page[/url]!

Bye!

notes.title: New Trailer Drop & Update!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

It's time for a quick update! We've been busy launching our free demo on Steam and presenting this vertical slice at a few events around Germany.

We started our event journey in May with the ever-great A MAZE. in our hometown Berlin. Then we traveled across the country to the far west to be part of the Indie Game Fest in Cologne! It was great to see so many new faces and dip our toes into the NRW game scene. We also won our first prize, the CRITICS' CHOICE AWARD! What an honor! 

Last weekend we were at the DOKOMI in Düsseldorf! So it's fair to say that we've been quite busy for the last months and it's been hard to keep our work rhythm between these events. 

A big thank you to everyone who gave us their demo feedback & we've already made some updates! We've reworked the whole save system & worked on some bugs! We are considering posting a detailed patch note list, but due to all the events we have to check in on each other which updates already have been done! 

We're currently discussing the (hopefully) final scope of the release version of MUKKE & planning the final steps. But we're getting there...

At least we finally managed to made a new trailer, 'cause the old one was way too... old. This new one shows a more up-to-date version & showcases all the different facets of the game we're dying to show you in the near future! It's going to be MASSIVE! Something the world has never seen before!(?)
[previewyoutube=_e-KpKkWhNA;full][/previewyoutube]

So stay tuned! Thx for the support, don't forget to [url=https://t.co/j0EuMObJXz]join our discord[/url], follow our socials (down below) & wishlist the game! 

And as a little MUKKE fan treat, there are also a few [url=https://stickersock.de/products/mukke-sticker-pack]stickers[/url] that you can get! Shipping is currently only available in Germany. 
It helps a lot! 

Thx again & read u soon!
cheers paolo

notes.title: FIRST PUBLIC DEMO
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/36a822e50fd3020256415056dda11dfab5918acc.png[/img]
[h1]Welcome to Mukke City! Play our brand new [b]DEMO[/b] now![/h1]

Hello folks! 
its us again,
APETENSE 

We are here with BIG NEWS! MUKKE has a [b]PUBLIC DEMO[/b]! 
Make your way to Mukke City and experience the first two chapters of MUKKE! 

Go, go, go! We are looking forward to your feedback so that MUKKE can become a super great music game! 
If you want to participate in playtests, feedback discussions or just have a chat with the community and the devs hop onto our Discord server and [url=https://discord.gg/4yrysAGf]join [b]MUKKE CITY NOW![/b][/url]
Let's do something cool together! :)

[h2][b]This is what you get in this demo:[/b][/h2]
- approx. 30 minutes of story-driven gameplay 
+ unlimited (but reduced) music creation

- meet some of the cool citizens of Mukke City
- take your first steps with MUKKE's music creation system
- get an insight into the daily routine of your stay in Mukke City

[h2][b]Things that are not included in the demo & will be added later:[/b][/h2]
- deeper music creation systems (sequencer, song structure, other?)
- Quality of life features (animation speed control, chapter selection, multiple save slots)
- overall polish (ux, bugfixes)
- potential online & music sharing features

[h2][b]!Disclaimer![/b][/h2]
The save data will not be able to be converted to the final game (we are currently figuring some things out :') )

Thx for playing & enjoy your time! ... in Mukke City!

apes out!

notes.title: MUKKE - The story-driven music game - DEVBLOG 02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/8f53e25a8267da066ce2ef079899818b39b073ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/49592232cdd8b2d3159a8d1065b61f0a597fb859.gif[/img]

Hey!
here’s paolo again, this time with a small pre-chorus for our next big chorus of a devblog! We are currently working on a [b]playable demonstration of MUKKE[/b], a demo you could say! A public demo, to be precise… so that everyone, but especially you, has the opportunity to try MUKKE for the first time! Exciting! But in the meantime, I’d like to share a little about the current state of the game and also about our small indie game collective so we’re all on the same page!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]

Let’s start with APETENSE because stories are always more exciting when you care about the people behind the thing you’re reading about!

We, APETENSE Interactive, are a small indie game collective based in East Berlin. We consist of three game designers who met at university and whose tastes in game development resonated quite well! The games we want to make shall be driven by creativity, not only in development but also for you to embrace. As we said in our first devblog, we believe that there is an inner longing for creativity and that games can channel this longing and act as a catalyst by providing you with enough satisfaction and motivation during the creation process to get ya to the point where creating is a joy and not a chore!

We are also three people with musical backgrounds in various ways, so producing music and sounds in any way is always an inspiration for everything we create!

We hope that our games can provide you with new experiences that can inspire you in many different ways! (or just entertain for more than 20 minutes… I think that’d also be a win for everyone!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]

Here you will find a small overview of the current APEs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/f20edb6e68ef43dbe38ac1edb7106d034f1ddf3f.png[/img]
joner is our technical lead! Between scripting and general problem-solving, he designs many of MUKKE’s game systems, mostly on paper! joner plays the violin, so notes on paper are good Friday night reading for him. He’s also dipped his toes into electronic music production, which we all have in common.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/eeb6a7bf50a105933cff66e8ea5d24254bdd27c8.png[/img]
soup is our art & narrative lead! Creating vivid characters is one of his specialties and all of MUKKE’s likable folks have passed through his brain and hands. He plays various instruments and likes to fiddle around in DAWs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/c77466ca45d022daa73adebc673a25f5b55420b6.png[/img]
paolo is our audio & ui lead! He loves it when audio & interfaces are not just an element to get right, but to experiment with fun & crazy ideas to give extra character to the game. He plays drums and is therefore more of a fan of musical reaction and interaction than music theory. So if you’re unsure whether you can make it as a music nooby in MUKKE, he’s on your side fighting the fight!

So that’s the current team!

We decided to call our little studio a collective because we value the autonomy of each team member in their creative endeavors and want to give everyone on the team their own space for creativity. We also want to collaborate with other people, be they voice actors/actresses, musicians, or in other fields of work, to get new impulses and create something new and inspiring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]

State of MUKKE

Now let’s get down to business. MUKKE is currently on its way to a first public demonstration, very-much-probably as a free downloadable demo here on Steam! We plan to keep this demo running until release so that everyone can try it out for themselves and get an insight into the current state of development of MUKKE. We’re not far away from a [working] demo, but it will still be a few weeks to go, so be prepared to get updates very soon! The demo will show many facets of MUKKE, be it a sneak peek at story elements or the music production. And to our delight, it will be published in [b]English as well as in German. Voice & text wise![/b]

Here are a few teasers:

We’ve been working on a little intro to set the mood:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/9ac4d28d2eb3e35922abff3e6534f98299471481.gif[/img]

soup arranged the intro story beats and the first voice acting rehearsals! It's going to be fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/a7edc939a844045e635ddc3ff0900bcc18ebe7ad.gif[/img]

We’re currently working on the tutorial and trying to find cool & immersive ways to get the controls & all the music across!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/25b8723ae672350ea2e8aac1468cf91428f3a35a.gif[/img]


For more info, follow MUKKE here on Steam, [url=https://twitter.com/apetense]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/apetension/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@apetense]TikTok[/url] or our [url=https://apetense.com/]website[/url]!

And if you’re super interested, wishlist MUKKE on Steam, we’d love to have you along for the ride!



Have a great, read u soon!

paolo @APETENSE
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/c77466ca45d022daa73adebc673a25f5b55420b6.png[/img]

notes.title: MUKKE - The story-driven music game - DEVBLOG 01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/82a9f788ef5ca01e4d2e9195e13ea9326cb23c3a.png[/img]
Hello, Greetings, hi . . .

at APETENSE we believe that most people are drawn to music in one way or another. Making sounds by banging on piano keys, singing along to your favourite song or tapping your feet to the beat.

There is an inner longing to express oneself through music and musical interaction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/049d5cdb2447b1935ea13b6caa47f04034482ed6.png[/img]
But in recent history, there have been few games that channel the creative and playful energy of musical instruments very well.

This is where we come in...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/1de736e694828554c876d33bc4dd24e306bc6fb4.png[/img]
MUKKE is all about creating your own music!

Create beats, melodies, loops, add sound effects as flavour, record pieces of music and combine them into songs. Send your tracks to radio stations and listen to them wherever you are. Or get on stage with your friends and perform in front of a crowd!

Sounds like a lot of fun to me!

And it's not as hard as it sounds! MUKKE takes you through all the steps at your own pace and teaches you the basics of making music in a fun way. Knowing that creating things can be intimidating at first and that too much freedom while creating can be counterproductive, we set boundaries and design a progression to give you a canvas with just enough tools to let your creativity flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/2275fe722d31fea655d384f9d008679b4d0ffea8.png[/img]
Besides the part about creating music, MUKKE offers a city full of unique characters and musical possibilities to explore and investigate, all inspired by West Berlin during the 80s.

We plan to share more about the characters, city life and West Berlin as the main inspiration in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/3e441879c421082ad29c6cab2f382ee9ba493267.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/f04ad994840d51b19d737bb81aa0262bbe38a2f4.png[/img]
We hope you’re interested in MUKKE and its development! For more info, follow MUKKE on Steam, [url=https://twitter.com/apetense]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/apetension/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@apetense]TikTok[/url] or this devblog series!

And if you’re super interested, wishlist MUKKE on Steam, we’d love to have you along for the ride!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579440/MUKKE/

Have a great, read u soon!

paolo @APETENSE

notes.title: AND ON THE SEVENTH DAY, THERE WAS MUKKE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44625647/c725eabe115e5388281d5b595a2ce85d850fba72.png[/img]

[b]ENG//[/b]
Hello internet!  

We're APETENSE, a small indie game collective consisting of three devs from Berlin.  

We're thrilled to announce our first title, MUKKE, a narrative driven music creation game!  We believe MUKKE is a funky & fresh experience that will shake up the music game market. It combines an exciting narrative with a detailed but easy-to-learn music tool!  

MUKKE is pretty early in development and we hope to see it take its final form in 2024/2025.  

Stay tuned for updates, demos & news!


[b]DEU//[/b]
Hallo Internet!

Wir sind APETENSE, ein kleines Indie-Game-Kollektiv, bestehend aus drei Entwicklern aus Berlin.

Wir sind hyped unser erstes Spiel ankündigen zu können: MUKKE, ein Musikspiel mit einer spannenden Geschichte und viel Raum für deine Kreativität!  Wir glauben, dass MUKKE ein frisches Erlebnis bietet und dem Musikspielgenre neuen Schwung verleihen wird. Es kombiniert eine spannende Geschichte mit einem detaillierten, aber leicht zu erlernenden Musik-Tool!

MUKKE befindet sich noch in einem sehr frühen Entwicklungsstadium und wir hoffen, dass es 2024/2025 seine endgültige Form annimmt.

Bleib' gerne dran für Updates, Demos und Neuigkeiten!
